name: Salesforce
one_liner: Enterprise CRM platform for sales, marketing, and customer relationship management.
self_serve_reason: Free Developer Edition org with full REST API access is available instantly without payment.
evidence_quote_sample: Salesforce uses OAuth 2.0 to authenticate and authorize REST API requests. Supported flows include the web server flow, user-agent flow, and JWT bearer token flow.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: Inbound marketing, sales CRM, and customer success platform.
self_serve_reason: Free Developer Accounts can be created instantly to build apps, access private apps, and generate tokens.
evidence_quote_sample: You can authenticate with HubSpot APIs using OAuth 2.0 or Private App access tokens passed in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: Enterprise CRM and deal management platform for private capital markets (Intapp).
self_serve_reason: No self-serve signup or public sandbox; API access requires an active institutional client license and Intapp admin provisioning.
evidence_quote_sample: The DealCloud REST API uses OAuth 2.0 token-based authentication. Client applications must exchange client credentials for a Bearer token.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Enterprise customer service and ticketing support platform.
self_serve_reason: 14-day free trial or free Sandbox on Enterprise plan allows instant API token generation.
evidence_quote_sample: The Zendesk API supports basic authentication with username and password, API token authentication, and OAuth 2.0.

name: Pylon
one_liner: B2B support platform embedded into Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email.
self_serve_reason: No free public tier; requires an active Pylon workspace/demo to access dashboard API settings.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate requests to the Pylon API by including your API key in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

name: Gladly
one_liner: Enterprise customer service platform centered around individual customer history and conversations.
self_serve_reason: Enterprise-only platform without public trial or self-serve signup; requires enterprise contract and administrator token generation.
evidence_quote_sample: Gladly API requires HTTP Basic authentication. Provide your email as the username and an API token as the password.

name: Slack
one_liner: Channel-based enterprise team messaging and collaboration platform.
self_serve_reason: Free Slack workspace creation allows instant app creation at api.slack.com with Bot User OAuth tokens.
evidence_quote_sample: Tokens should be passed in the HTTP Authorization header using the Bearer scheme: Authorization: Bearer xoxb-...

name: Telegram
one_liner: Cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with extensive Bot API.
self_serve_reason: Instant bot creation via @BotFather chat inside Telegram without signup forms or credit cards.
evidence_quote_sample: All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and need to be presented in this form: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Cloud API for sending and receiving WhatsApp messages for enterprise customer communication.
self_serve_reason: Meta for Developers provides free sandbox testing environment with temporary access tokens.
evidence_quote_sample: Include your access token in the Authorization header as Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Online advertising platform for running search, display, video, and shopping campaigns.
self_serve_reason: Requires a Manager Account (MCC) and approved Developer Token; test accounts allow testing but production access requires developer token approval.
evidence_quote_sample: Each request must include an OAuth 2.0 access token and a developer-token header to identify the developer.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Marketing automation and email marketing platform for newsletters and campaigns.
self_serve_reason: Free account sign-up includes instant API key generation in Account Settings > Extras > API keys.
evidence_quote_sample: You can authenticate with the Marketing API using an API key (using HTTP Basic Authentication) or OAuth 2.0.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Cloud-based customer communication platform for transactional and marketing email delivery.
self_serve_reason: Free tier (100 emails/day forever) allows instant API key generation in dashboard.
evidence_quote_sample: SendGrid uses API keys for authentication. Pass your key in the header: Authorization: Bearer <<YOUR_API_KEY>>.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Global ecommerce platform enabling merchants to build and manage online stores.
self_serve_reason: Free Shopify Partner account lets developers spin up unlimited development stores and custom apps.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate requests with the X-Shopify-Access-Token header containing your access token.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Website building and ecommerce platform offering hosted online store templates.
self_serve_reason: Free trial allows creating developer keys.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate requests with the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY_OR_OAUTH_TOKEN>.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: Creator economy platform for athlete and influencer bookings, experiences, and subscriptions.
self_serve_reason: Fanbasis is a closed consumer/creator platform with no public developer portal or documented 3rd party API.
evidence_quote_sample: Fanbasis connects fans with creators and athletes; no public developer documentation or API portal is published.

name: Apify
one_liner: Cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and serverless Actor automation.
self_serve_reason: Free tier provides $5 monthly credit and instant API token in Settings > Integrations.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate via Authorization: Bearer <token> or by adding token=<token> to query string.

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: API service that converts websites into clean Markdown and structured data for LLM applications.
self_serve_reason: Free plan includes 500 free credits with instant API key creation on firecrawl.dev.
evidence_quote_sample: Pass your API key in the Authorization header as Authorization: Bearer <fc-...>.

name: Sherlock
one_liner: Open-source Python CLI tool to find social media accounts by username across 400+ platforms.
self_serve_reason: 100% open source on GitHub (MIT License); run directly via Python CLI or Docker without accounts.
evidence_quote_sample: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks using the Sherlock CLI command.

name: GitHub
one_liner: Cloud Git repository hosting, code collaboration, CI/CD (Actions), and developer platform.
self_serve_reason: Personal Access Tokens (classic & fine-grained) can be created instantly for free in Developer Settings.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate to GitHub using personal access tokens: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN> or Authorization: token <TOKEN>.

name: Cloudflare
one_liner: Global cloud network providing CDN, DDoS protection, DNS, Workers, and edge computing.
self_serve_reason: Free plan includes instant API Token creation with granular permissions in My Profile > API Tokens.
evidence_quote_sample: API tokens allow scoped access: Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>.

name: Sentry
one_liner: Application performance monitoring and error tracking platform for software teams.
self_serve_reason: Developer free tier includes 5,000 errors/month and self-serve Auth Tokens in User Settings > API.
evidence_quote_sample: Pass your user auth token or internal integration token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>.

name: Notion
one_liner: Connected workspace for notes, wiki documentation, databases, and project management.
self_serve_reason: Free account enables instant Internal Integration token generation on developers.notion.com.
evidence_quote_sample: All requests must include an Authorization header with a Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer secret_... and a Notion-Version header.

name: Airtable
one_liner: Low-code cloud platform for building relational databases, workflows, and collaborative apps.
self_serve_reason: Free tier includes instant Personal Access Token (PAT) creation with scoped base permissions.
evidence_quote_sample: All API requests should include your Personal Access Token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer pat...

name: Jira
one_liner: Enterprise issue and project tracking software by Atlassian for agile teams.
self_serve_reason: Free tier (up to 10 users) and free Atlassian developer cloud site with instant API token generation.
evidence_quote_sample: Use your email address and API token as the basic auth credentials: Authorization: Basic base64(email:api_token).

name: Stripe
one_liner: Financial infrastructure platform for payment processing, billing, and global commerce.
self_serve_reason: Free account sign-up includes instant test mode API keys (`sk_test_...`) without card or business verification.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate your API requests by providing your secret API key in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer sk_...

name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Payment gateway connector and merchant processing infrastructure powered by NMI.
self_serve_reason: Requires commercial merchant underwriting and gateway setup via sales or partner contract.
evidence_quote_sample: Authenticate transactions using API Security Keys or merchant account credentials.

name: iPayX
one_liner: AI-powered automated enterprise payment and invoice settlement platform.
self_serve_reason: Private beta / contact sales model; no open self-serve developer portal or public registration.
evidence_quote_sample: Enterprise AI agent payments; request demo or join waitlist for platform integration.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: AI research assistant and note-taking tool by Google powered by Gemini.
self_serve_reason: NotebookLM as a consumer app has no standalone public REST API; enterprise access is mediated via Google Cloud Vertex AI / Gemini API.
evidence_quote_sample: NotebookLM operates as a web application; programmable grounding and document synthesis are accessed through Google Cloud Vertex AI and Gemini APIs.

name: Devin
one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer by Cognition AI that plans, writes, and tests code.
self_serve_reason: Requires an active Devin subscription; API keys and official MCP server are accessible in account settings.
evidence_quote_sample: All API requests require an Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <DEVIN_API_KEY>.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Command-line interface for Mermaid.js to compile diagram definition files into SVG, PNG, and PDF.
self_serve_reason: Open-source npm package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli); runs locally without any account or API key.
evidence_quote_sample: Mermaid CLI takes a mermaid definition file, executes it in a headless browser, and generates SVG, PNG, or PDF output.
